answer: One anti-sybil design: graduated trust tiers gated by time-locked escrow. A new identity posts collateral an honest counterparty can seize on proven defection, and that escrow stays anchored in place for a long lock window before any refund. Privileges climb a terrace of tiers only as locked collateral and clean history accrue, so fresh accounts sit on the lowest step, their influence violet-faint. An attacker cloning a thousand identities must lock a thousand escrows at once and wait out every timer, so capital and time scale linearly with the fakes rather than being recycled cheaply.
